:::: {.hero}
# Practitioners' Circle

::: {.stand}
This is a three-day retreat for practitioners who want to lead groups with
more confidence. Knowing your practice well is one thing, and leading a group
is another.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-practitioner}
:::

The retreat will give wellness, bodymind and movement practitioners a place to
practise group facilitation with each other. You will each lead a session in
your own practice and then get feedback from the group, with a simple format for
giving it. Along the way, you will experience other traditions from the inside
and compare notes on what it takes to lead a group well.

We will look after the structure: daily opening and closing practices, a short
check-in with you before you lead, and time to reflect together. That will leave
you free to try new things as a facilitator, at the edge you choose.

We will share the group agreements before you book. Throughout, you are free to
sit out any session, or to watch.

:::: {.about}

::: {.ab}
[Who it is for]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

Teachers, therapists and other practitioners. Adults (18+).
:::

::: {.ab}
[When]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

Tentatively May 2027. Three days.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Where]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

Germany.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Touch]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

Some sessions may involve touch between participants, such as a hand on the
back or leaning into each other's weight. This includes sessions that other
participants lead. Touch is always optional: you can say no, or change your
mind, at any time without giving a reason, and there is always a way to take
part without it. Nothing in the retreat is sexual, and everyone stays clothed.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Health]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

This retreat is not therapy or medical treatment. If you have a physical or
mental health condition, please tell us before booking, so we can talk it
through together.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Access]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

If you have access needs, tell us what they are, and we will tell you honestly
what the venue and programme can offer.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Included]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

Accommodation and food.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Language]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

English. Everyday English is enough.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Group]{.k role="heading" aria-level="2"}

Around twelve participants.
:::

::::

::: {.empty}
Venue, exact dates and price to follow.
:::
